items.reason: Same agent. No INN is given in the record; the manual says not to invent one and to use the name as first written ('Recombinant Human Endostatin'). The moiety mapping script will normalise either form.

Irinotecan is not established standard care for recurrent glioma, and the record aims 'to confirm the efficacy and safety of the combination of rh-ES, temozolomide and irinotecan'; under D31-B7 soc_backbone is reserved for established standard care, so irinotecan is a candidate (experimental_combination), with endostatin as co-candidate. Temozolomide stays soc_backbone.
